name: TOHID-AGENT
description: TOHID-AGENT V8.0 — Autonomous WhatsApp AI Agent by Tohid

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key. Leave blank if you use Gemini only.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google Gemini API key. Leave blank if you use OpenAI only.

AI_PROVIDER.description: AI provider mode: auto, openai, or gemini.

MONGO_URI.description: MongoDB connection URI. Required for persistent WhatsApp auth, memory and task history.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Owner WhatsApp number in international format, digits only. Example: 9198XXXXXXXX.

GITHUB_OWNER.description: GitHub account/organization owner used by the GitHub agent.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub personal access token. Required only for GitHub API automation.

PAIRING_NUMBER.description: WhatsApp number used to generate the pairing code, in international format, digits only.

HEROKU_API_KEY.description: Optional Heroku API key for managing other Heroku apps from WhatsApp.

VERCEL_TOKEN.description: Optional Vercel token for Vercel deployment management.

RENDER_API_KEY.description: Optional Render API key for Render management.

KOYEB_API_TOKEN.description: Optional Koyeb API token for Koyeb management.
